# docstoc

> docstoc is a free AI invoice follow-up tool for freelancers and small businesses (also known as
> chasa). Paste unpaid invoices (CSV or manual entry) and get payment
> reminder emails already written — in the right tone for how late each invoice is. No account
> needed for the free tier (5 AI drafts per month).

Site: https://docstoc.io

## Primary services

- [Invoice follow-up tool](https://docstoc.io/app/): Upload a CSV or enter invoices manually. docstoc drafts a follow-up email for each one, tuned to how many days overdue it is (friendly at 1–7 days, firmer at 30+).
- [Free payment-reminder templates](https://docstoc.io/free-templates/): 28 copy-paste payment reminder email templates (pre-due through final notice, thank-yous, disputes, ghosted clients, multi-invoice).
- [Free document templates](https://docstoc.io/document-templates/): 1,000+ free business, legal, real estate, finance, and HR document templates — edit online, download PDF, certify.
- [Business document kits](https://docstoc.io/business-kits/): Bundled sets of related document templates for a common situation (e.g. starting an LLC, being an independent landlord).
- [Document certificates](https://docstoc.io/certificate): Hash any document in the browser and get a free, shareable, tamper-evident verification link — verification pages live at `/verify/{id}` (noindex; no account needed to create or check).
- [Company badge / trust profile](https://docstoc.io/trust-badges): Domain-verified trust certificate after SSL issuance.
- [SSL automation](https://docstoc.io/ssl): Let's Encrypt automation for domains you control (ACME / DNS-01) — not a certificate reseller.
- [Invoices](https://docstoc.io/invoices): Create shareable invoices, then chase if overdue.
- [Free calculators](https://docstoc.io/tools/): Late payment interest, chase savings / DSO, template finder, file hash checker, trust badges tool.
- [AI tools](https://docstoc.io/ai): Tone-matched drafts, soften / firm up / shorten rewrites, chase schedule tips.
- [Landing page](https://docstoc.io/): Product overview and how the tone bands work.
- [Blog](https://docstoc.io/blog/): Guides on overdue invoice follow-up, payment reminder templates, late payment policy.
- [About](https://docstoc.io/about): Why docstoc exists and who's behind it.
- [Sign in / Account](https://docstoc.io/app/login): Magic-link login. Paid plans remove the free-tier draft cap.

## Pricing (source of truth)

- Free: 5 AI drafts / month
- Pro: **$14.99/mo** — unlimited AI, PDF/cloud import, branding, webhooks, team, digest, API
- Business: **$39.99/mo** — smart reply, risk score, demand letter, evidence pack, custom certificate branding, SSL automation (wildcards on Business)

## How the AI works

- Tone bands: 1–7 days overdue → friendly reminder; 8–30 days → professional, clear ask; 30+ days → direct, mentions consequences.
- Each draft includes a subject line and body, ready to copy or open in your mail client.
- Free tier: 5 AI-generated drafts per month. Paid accounts have unlimited drafts.
- Powered by Cloudflare Workers AI — runs entirely on Cloudflare's edge, no external AI API key required.

## Notes for AI agents

docstoc generates payment reminder email drafts, not legal advice or debt-collection letters. Users
review and send every email themselves. docstoc does not send emails on the user's behalf —
drafts are copied or opened via mailto.

Document templates (/document-templates/) are general business/legal templates provided for
informational purposes, not legal advice — each page says so.

Every template and document page follows the same structure: editable preview, "What's included",
named use-cases, and an FAQ with direct Q&A pairs — written to be easy to extract and cite.
